# Why the red car moved slowly

The red car is the red Mazda CX-5 SUV in the kerb-side lane directly ahead
of the orange KamAZ dump truck loaded with snow. Both are travelling the
same direction, from the background toward and past the camera, with the
red car downstream of the truck in the right-most, kerb-side lane.

It moves slowly because it is not going straight through. It is braking
and preparing to turn right at the junction immediately ahead, while the
cars in the lane to its left and east are through traffic going straight.

Four things in the video show this explicitly. First, the direction sign
on the left at the start of the clip names the junction ahead: straight
on for ulitsa Respubliki and side exits for ulitsa Gertsena and ulitsa
Malygina at the junction ahead, so a turning exit exists just past the
camera position. Second,
the red car is correctly positioned for that move in the kerb-side,
right-turn lane, whereas the silver hatchback, grey Toyota Camry, blue
Mazda and later white Lada and black Matiz that overtake it are in the
next, through lane. Third, the camera-facing, western, right-hand
headlamp area of the red Mazda shows a steady amber indication through
the first two to three seconds while it creeps forward, consistent with a
right-turn indication, while its front wheels stay straight because the
turn itself is still ahead beyond the frame. Fourth, its motion is a slow
crawl past the central pole while the next-lane cars cross the same
static background much faster and pull from behind it to ahead of it.

That is why the speed difference occurs. A vehicle slowing, braking and
yielding to make a right turn must crawl, and it briefly holds up the
straight-ahead truck behind it in the same lane. The next lane is
unaffected because those drivers are continuing straight on Respubliki
and maintain speed. There is no standing obstruction, closure or bad
surface in the red car's lane that also stops the truck at the same spot;
the truck keeps a steadier approach until it is itself checked by the
car ahead. The slowness is therefore driver maneuver behavior, a
right turn off Respubliki at the signed junction just ahead, not a
property of the lane.
